steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Material categories: woods (hardwood, softwood, manufactured), metals (ferrous, non-ferrous), polymers (thermoplastic, thermoset), ceramics. | Key Fact: Manufacturing processes: subtractive (CNC, laser cutting), additive (3D printing), forming (vacuum forming, injection moulding). | Key Fact: Material properties determine suitability: strength, weight, flexibility, durability, cost, sustainability and aesthetic qualities. | Key Fact: Joining methods: permanent (welding, adhesive, rivets) and temporary (screws, bolts, nuts) — choose based on function and disassembly needs.
